source.test: Pack-managed guard section -- whole-pack escape hatch

input.operation: re-run the pack importer against this server with an explicit replace intent

expected.reason: The decided contract's escape hatch: an EXPLICIT whole-pack replacement (the same pack importer P8.19/P8.20 build, re-run deliberately against an already-pack-managed server) is allowed even though every individual mutation is refused. phase8-scope.md flags this has no MSC 1 precedent at all -- `importModpack`/CurseForge import run unconditionally today regardless of `packManaged`, so "replace" and "first import" are literally the same unguarded code path in the oracle; Phase 8 must build the distinction between an explicit replace and an accidental one, not just permit the existing unconditional path.
